question: Is the supermassive black hole at the center of the Milky Way dangerous?
short_answer: No. Sagittarius A* is 26,000 light-years away and its gravitational pull only affects stars in the central galactic bulge. It poses zero danger to Earth.
full_explanation: Sagittarius A* contains ~4.1 million solar masses, but because Earth orbits in the spiral disk 26,000 light-years out, the local solar gravity dominates our planet's motion completely.
